title: The first message ever sent on the internet was 'lo'
hook: In 1969, two computers tried to send the word 'login'. They got as far as 'lo', then crashed.

title: The glow stick was invented in one afternoon
hook: A scientist mixed two chemicals one afternoon and saw a cold glow. Today the army buys millions of glow sticks.

title: The man who invented changing the clocks just wanted to catch more bugs
hook: This weekend America turns its clocks back, because a New Zealand insect collector wanted more daylight after work.

title: Two TV systems launched on the same day, and a coin toss picked the winner
hook: 90 years ago, two rival TV systems were ready to launch. A coin toss decided which one went first.
